speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing right leg weakness, an unsteady gait, multiple falls, forgetfulness, and paranoid behavior. To help me understand the severity and nature of these symptoms, have you noticed any changes in your vision, such as double vision or blurring, or any numbness in your arms or legs?

speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. He has also been paranoid, agitated, and restless recently.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Angiitis of the Central Nervous System (PACNS).
